description: Answer questions about the shop itself (shipping, payment, returns, complaints, warranty, installation) with verbatim snippets from the shop's published pages and articles, each with its URL (snippets may be empty for a page without quotable text, e.g. a form: link it). Quote or paraphrase only these snippets and link the URL; when answers is empty, the answer could not be found in the published information: say so and give the contact.

question.description: Customer question about the shop in the shop language, e.g. 'Kolik stojí doprava?' or 'Jak vrátit zboží?'.
